[Verse 1]
[G]How much of my [Em]mother has my mo-
[C]ther left in me? [G]
How much of my love will be insane
[D]to some degree? And
[G]what about this [Em]feeling that I'm
[C]never good enough? [G]Will it wash
[Em]out in the [G]water, or is it al-
[D]ways in the blood?
[G]

[Verse 2]
[G]How much of my [Em]father am I des-
[C]tined to become? [G]Will I dim
the lights inside me just to sa-
[D]tisfy someone? Will I let
[G]this woman kill [Em]me, or do away
[C]with jealous love? [G]Will it wash
[Em]out in the [G]water, or is it al-
[D]ways in the blood?
[G]I can

[Chorus]
[Em]feel the love I want [G]I can
[C]feel the love I need [G]But it's
[Em]never gonna come [G]the way I am
[D]Could I change
[Em]it if I [G]wanted? Can I
[C]rise above the [G]flood? Will it wash
[Em]out in the [G]water Or is it al-
[D]ways in the blood?
[G]

[Verse 3]
[G]How much like my [Em]brothers do my bro-
[C]thers wanna be? [G]Does a bro-
ken home become another bro-
[D]ken family? Or will we be
[G]there for each [Em]other like nobo-
[C]dy ever could? [G]Will it wash
[Em]out in the [G]water, or is it al-
[D]ways in the blood?
